# Catapult

> Catapult is an SSH deployment tool for Node.js applications. It manages versioned releases, atomic publishes, rollback, shared paths, and composable deployment tasks without requiring an agent on the target server.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://catapultjs.com/)
- [Getting started](https://catapultjs.com/guide/getting-started)
- [Configuration](https://catapultjs.com/guide/json-configuration)
- [Deployment pipeline](https://catapultjs.com/guide/pipeline)
- [Recipes](https://catapultjs.com/guide/recipes/)
- [CLI reference](https://catapultjs.com/guide/cli/)
- [Agent skill](https://catapultjs.com/guide/agent-skills)
- [API reference](https://catapultjs.com/guide/api)
